root_cause.text: In the error path of `__xe_exec_queue_init()`, when LRC creation failed after queue initialization (which allocates a `guc_id` and adds the queue to `exec_queue_lookup`), the code only freed already-created LRCs but did not call `q->ops->fini()` to remove the queue from the GuC list and free the `guc_id`, leaving a partially initialized queue entry in the lookup list that could later cause a use-after-free or invalid memory reference.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "Every call to queue init should have a corresponding fini call. Skipping this would mean skipping removal of the queue from GuC list (which is part of guc_id allocation). A damaged queue stored in exec_queue_lookup list would lead to invalid memory reference, sooner or later." The patch replaces the manual LRC freeing in the `err_lrc` label with a call to `__xe_exec_queue_fini(q)`, which properly invokes `q->ops->fini()` before releasing LRCs.
